CustomField.description: For Running_User resolution: the field path on the User object that resolves to the target record ID. Examples: "Contact.AccountId" (community user Account), "ContactId" (community user Contact), "AccountId" (partner user Account).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: User object field path to resolve the record. E.g. "Contact.AccountId" for community users, "ContactId" for portal users.
CustomField.label: User Lookup Field
